notes:
Summary: BreezeFlow is a mid-market CCaaS vendor focused on automated deflection and agent augmentation. Large US-EU customer base; high chat volumes (peak 12k concurrent sessions across tenants). Cost-sensitive — unit economics critical. Interested in a hybrid approach: hosted for quick rollout, Dedicated for predictable cost/throughput in peak regions. Strong interest in Redwood Optimize advising on batching/caching and quantization profiles.

Recent timeline (bullets from CRM):
- 2026-02-10: Intro call (Jordan + Priya) — overview of Redwood capabilities; BreezeFlow wants benchmarks vs current in-house LLM stack.
- 2026-02-25: Product deep-dive (SE demo) — live demo of agent assist & tool-calling. Captured Fireflies ff_20260225_9xwQ2.
- 2026-03-01: Security kickoff (Luis + security team) — requested SOC2 cert, audit log samples, KMS flow. Raised SEC-441.
- 2026-03-05: Pricing/POC scoping call — asked for 4-week POC focused on chat deflection and ticket summarization with cost reporting. Gmail thread thread-CA+purchase-req-2026 referenced.

Use-case specifics / requirements (copied from notes and call):
- Core: high-volume chat deflection (automated resolution + escalation triage), agent-assist snippets for CSRs, automatic ticket summarization for post-chat ops.
- Targets: 30-60ms median token latency for agent-assist; <=200ms tail for deflection responses; throughput to handle 8-12k concurrent low-latency sessions during marketing spikes.
- Cost sensitivity: target blended per-conversation cost <= $0.05 (tokens + infra). POC must show unit econ improvements vs current gpt-like endpoints.
- Reliability: graceful degradation required (fallback models, regional routing). Need canary rollouts and automatic fallback to cheaper quantized variants under overload.
- Model preferences: open-weight variants OK if quantized; explicit desire for quantization guidance and validated quality checks (redwood Optimize).
- Caching/Batching: want prefix/KV caching for multi-turn sessions, continuous batching heuristic to cut per-token cost during off-peak without hurting latency.
- Tool-calling: existing integrations (Zendesk, Salesforce) — require structured tool-calls with traceable audit logs.

Security & compliance notes:
- Must integrate with corporate SSO (SAML) and support per-tenant audit logs.
- Data residency: EU tenant data must remain in eu-west; options: region pinning or Dedicated in EU.
- Retention: 90-day transcript retention plus long-term audit records.

POC plan (agreed):
- Week 0: provisioning (Redwood hosted sandbox + RSA-based SSO test).
- Week 1-2: run traffic replay (ingest 100k past chats) to measure batching/caching impact + latency profile.
- Week 3: live shadow on 5% of prod traffic during low period.
- Week 4: cost & quality review; produce recommendation (quantized models vs full-precision) and deployment plan.

Key quotes/notes from stakeholders:
- Head of Ops: "If you can cut our per-conversation cost by 3x without dropping NPS, we go all in."
- CTO: concerned about model drift and rollback speed under spikes. Wants clear rollback and canary strategy.

Open technical questions (from SE):
- How does Redwoods continuous batching impact 95th percentile latency in real traffic? Need sample traces.
- Validation harness for quantized model quality checks — can Redwood run our prompt/eval suite inside POC?

Next steps (short):

- SE to provide sample latency traces and suggested quantization profiles (Priya) — done by 2026-03-15.
- Security team to receive SOC2 package + audit log exemplar (Luis) — in progress.
